points: The neighbors said a son is born to Naomi, because the seed was raised up in the name of her dead husband and sons; that is why Obed is called hers.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah

points: Naomi took the child, and laid it in her bosom, and became nurse unto it; and the women her neighbours gave it a name, saying, There is a son born to Naomi; and they called his name Obed: he is the father of Jesse, the father of David.
Raising up seed does not give a child two fathers; the record says Boaz begat Obed, not Mahlon, because Mahlon was dead.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah

points: Generation goes back to genes and genealogy: Judas begat Phares and Zara of Thamar, Phares begat Esrom, down to Naasson, Salmon, Booz of Rachab, Obed of Ruth, Jesse and David the king.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah

points: Boaz begat Obed of Ruth is where levirate marriage actually shows up, but we will not be bamboozled by a spin move into an Old Testament law that has nothing to do with the question asked.
